title: OpenCode Machine State (P1-B Slim)
description: JSON Schema for .opencode/state/machine.json — validates only meta + contracts. Sub-states are stored in separate files (.opencode/state/*.json) and SQLite DB (substate_kv table). See machine.schema.full.json for the original monolithic schema (pre-P1-B).

meta.description: Machine metadata — version, project identity, and timestamps.

version.description: SemVer of the state machine format.

revision.description: Monotonic revision counter incremented per state mutation (RVW-REVIEW-01).

contracts.description: List of contract files tracked by keystone hash.

items.description: Relative path to a contract file.
